historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah: The Prolegomena. Translated by Franz Rosenthal. Princeton: Princeton University Press, 1958. Saamii is mentioned as a Berber ruler of the Maghreb (North Africa) in the 11th century.

Al-Bakri, Al-Masudi, and Ibn Khaldun. The Geography of Ibn Khaldun. Translated by Roger le Tourneau. New York: J.J. Augustin, 1951. Saamii is noted as a chief of the Sanhaja Berbers, ruling from Aghmat in present-day Morocco, in the early 11th century.
